summary: Applied three spec review repairs: prepare.post live flow context, finalize-cleanup durable artifact/follow-up data path, and public plugin agent API/context.

items.title: Prepare hook has no live flow context
items.rationale: Updated the spec to require prepare.post lifecycle execution after prepare writes flow.json, with newly created flow state including hook snapshot, spec path, runId, and linked issue.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements R4, data_flow prepare.post entry, AC16, and T-3 acceptance now cover the required live flow context.

items.title: Finalize hook has no successful-output or artifact path
items.target: R4 / Design Principles / src/lib/plugin-registry.js runFlowCommandHooks and src/flow/lib/run-finalize-cleanup.js
items.rationale: Updated the spec to require finalize-cleanup.post execution while durable spec/issue-log/artifact paths are available and to aggregate successful hook followUps/data into the finalize-cleanup result without schema interpretation.
items.evidence: spec.json design_principles, data_flow finalize-cleanup entry, requirements R4, AC17, clarifications, and T-3 acceptance now cover the data path.

items.title: Plugin AI fallback lacks a public integration point
items.target: R5 / plugin command and hook context
items.rationale: Updated the spec to require a workflow-neutral public plugin agent API/context exposing generic agent resolve/call capability and needed root config values such as lang.
items.evidence: spec.json data_flow plugin context entry, requirements R5, AC18, clarifications, and T-4 acceptance now cover the public integration point.
